subject.title: [Bug]: active-memory embedded run cannot resolve Lossless Claw lcm_* tools despite runtime plugin inspect showing them registered

question: Should this move to a repair PR before a live Lossless Claw embedded-run reproduction exists?
rationale: The documented behavior appears valid, but the exact runtime boundary is not proven without installing Lossless Claw and exercising active-memory on current `main`.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Run or request a current-main Gateway proof with Lossless Claw installed and `toolsAllow` set to the three `lcm_*` tools before authorizing a fix.

options.title: Queue source-only repair
options.body: Allow a focused repair attempt from source inspection, accepting higher risk that it fixes the wrong plugin-tool boundary.

options.title: Clarify unsupported setup
options.body: If maintainers decide external context-engine tools should not be callable from active-memory, update docs/config validation instead of repairing the embedded run.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Run or request a current-main Gateway proof with Lossless Claw installed and `toolsAllow` set to the three `lcm_*` tools before authorizing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The active-memory custom recall-tool feature and Lossless Claw documentation were introduced through this person's merged PR history.
